name: DIALOGUE.386
description: A text mode interface from the DOS era. Navy panels inside double white borders with hard black drop shadows, bright green on anything you can press, and a dithered dot grid behind the lot. Built on deer's System-Glass.
author: jce, on top of System-Glass by deer

variants.name: Base
variants.description: The theme on your own system fonts. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is embedded.

variants.name: IBM Plex
variants.description: IBM Plex Sans for the interface, IBM Plex Mono for code, both embedded in the file.

variants.name: IBM Plex Mono
variants.description: IBM Plex Mono everywhere, tightened letter spacing to go with it.

variants.name: B612
variants.description: B612 for the interface, B612 Mono for code. Drawn for aircraft cockpit displays.

variants.name: B612 Mono
variants.description: B612 Mono everywhere, tightened letter spacing to go with it.

variants.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next
variants.description: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for the interface, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for code. Drawn by the Braille Institute for low vision readers.

variants.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono
variants.description: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono everywhere, tightened letter spacing to go with it.
